issues.title: Windows-only Sha256 lacks platform guards
issues.description: The HashAlgorithm::Sha256 variant is only used for Windows-specific WIX tooling downloads but lacks #[cfg(target_os = "windows")] guards. Platform-specific code should use conditional compilation attributes to ensure it only compiles on supported platforms.
issues.rule_name: Platform-Specific Code Must Use Appropriate Conditional Compilation

issues.title: GitHub mirror URL ignored, always downloads from original URL
issues.description: The function `generate_github_alternative_url` computes an alternative mirror URL from environment variables but then returns the original GitHub URL instead of the computed mirror URL. This breaks the GitHub mirror functionality that users configure via `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR` or `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR_TEMPLATE` environment variables. When GitHub has rate limits or accessibility issues, the configured mirrors will be silently ignored and downloads will fail from the original GitHub URLs. The bug occurs because `alt_url` is renamed to `_alt_url` (indicating it's unused) and `url.to_owned()` is returned instead of `alt_url`.

issues.title: Version mismatch between CLI and Tauri core in metadata
issues.description: The metadata-v2.json file incorrectly declares tauri core version as "2.9.3" when the actual Tauri runtime version remains at "2.9.2" (as confirmed in Cargo.lock). This PR only updates tauri-cli and tauri-bundler to 2.9.3, not the core Tauri runtime. This metadata file is used by the CLI to verify version compatibility and inform users about which versions work together. The incorrect version could lead to confusion about compatibility, failed version checks, or users attempting to use mismatched versions thinking they are compatible.

issues.title: Version bump without corresponding .changes change file in this PR
issues.description: This PR bumps crate versions (and updates changelogs) but deletes all existing entries in `.changes/` and does not add a new change file. Per the rule, user-facing/functional changes requiring a version bump must include a covector change file under `.changes/` documenting the bump and summary.
issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File

issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14409 - Apply Version Updates From Current Changes

structured_output.summary:
This is a release-bookkeeping PR. It bumps tauri-bundler to 2.7.3 and tauri-cli / @tauri-apps/cli to 2.9.3, consumes the pending `.changes/*.md` files into CHANGELOG entries, and updates Cargo.lock and metadata-v2.json. The version and changelog wiring is internally consistent: the CLI pins tauri-bundler 2.7.3, the npm package matches the CLI version, and the changelog entries line up with the deleted change files.

The PR is not purely version bumps, though. `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs` contains two code edits that no changelog entry describes. The first one is a real regression. `generate_github_alternative_url` now discards the mirror URL it computes (`|_alt_url|`) and returns the original GitHub `url` instead. Any user who sets `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR` or `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR_TEMPLATE` will silently fall back to github.com, which is the exact case the mirror feature exists to avoid. The second edit removes `#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]` from `HashAlgorithm::Sha256`. That is harmless, since `sha2` is an unconditional dependency and `dead_code` is already allowed, but it is an unannounced scope change.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The version bumps and changelogs are correct, but the mirror-URL change in `http_utils.rs` silently breaks the `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR*` feature. The PR is a release bump, so this unrelated code change should either be reverted or split into its own reviewed PR with a changelog entry. The mirror regression is a clear correctness bug and should block merge.

architecture.overview:
tauri-bundler downloads build tools (WiX, NSIS, linuxdeploy plugins) over HTTP through `utils/http_utils.rs`. For GitHub-hosted URLs, `create_agent_and_url` first asks `generate_github_alternative_url` for a mirror. The mirror comes either from a URL template env var or from a base mirror env var. If a mirror is found, the function returns a ureq agent with the bundler user-agent together with the rewritten URL. Otherwise it falls back to the base agent and the original URL. Release tooling in tauri-cli also depends on the bundler crate through a path dependency pinned to a version.

This PR does not change that flow architecturally. It bumps versions in Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, package.json, and metadata-v2.json, and it moves the pending change files into CHANGELOG.md. However, the `generate_github_alternative_url` edit breaks the flow: the mirror URL is computed and then thrown away, so the agent is built but the request always goes to the original GitHub URL.
steps: Entry point: `download` / `download_and_verify` in `http_utils.rs` are called by the WiX, NSIS and linuxdeploy paths in tauri-bundler. Each call resolves its agent and URL through `create_agent_and_url`.

Mirror resolution: `generate_github_alternative_url` tries `generate_github_mirror_url_from_template` and then `generate_github_mirror_url_from_base`. In the base commit it returned the computed mirror URL. In this PR it returns `url.to_owned()`, which is the regression.
Hash verification: `HashAlgorithm` and `verify_hash` now compile `Sha256` on every platform. Previously it was Windows-only. The change is safe but unrelated to the version bump.
Release wiring: tauri-cli pins `tauri-bundler = 2.7.3` and `@tauri-apps/cli` pins `tauri-cli@2.9.3`. Cargo.lock and metadata-v2.json are bumped to match.

Changelogs: the deleted `.changes/*.md` entries are reflected in the bundler, tauri-cli and npm CLI CHANGELOG.md files. Those entries are accurate and their issue and commit references are consistent with the existing entries.

findings.title: Mirror URL computed but discarded, so mirror env vars are ignored
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs`, `generate_github_alternative_url` (around lines 45-61) binds the mirror URL as `_alt_url` and returns `url.to_owned()`, so the TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR* mirror is ignored. Restore the mirror URL: rename the closure parameter back to `alt_url` and return it as the second tuple element instead of `url.to_owned()`. Match the original code in the base commit (57faad0b). Add a unit test that sets the mirror env var and asserts the function returns the mirror URL rather than the GitHub URL.

findings.title: Unrelated HashAlgorithm::Sha256 cfg change not in changelog or PR scope
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs`, the `#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]` attributes were removed from the `HashAlgorithm::Sha256` variant (around line 100) and its match arm in `verify_hash` (around line 120). This change is out of scope for a version-bump PR and has no changelog entry. Restore the two `#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]` attributes to match the base commit (57faad0b), or, if the change is intentional, move it to its own PR with a changelog entry.

findings.title: Version bumps, changelogs and lockfile are consistent
findings.body: The release bookkeeping is done correctly. tauri-bundler is bumped to 2.7.3 in both Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock. tauri-cli is bumped to 2.9.3, and its path dependency on tauri-bundler is updated to 2.7.3. `metadata-v2.json` and `packages/cli/package.json` both move to 2.9.3, and the npm CLI changelog matches. The deleted `.changes/*.md` files are reflected in the CHANGELOG entries for the affected packages, and the PR and commit references are consistent with the existing changelog format.
